_doc: PR 00 baseline record for the latent game reconstruction initiative (plans/game_reconstruction_mega_plan.md). Captures the reproducible starting point before any reconstruction code is added. No production file changed in this PR.

git.note: Owner working-tree changes are intentionally preserved and not touched by this PR.

unmatched_game_ids.note: Game 22501183 appears in nba_players.csv without a matching team-game pair. Canonicalization must quarantine it, not crash or fabricate a team row.

turnover_residual_distribution.description: For matched (GAME_ID, TEAM_ID) groups, team TOV minus summed player TOV. Negative residual is forbidden; positive residual is represented as TEAM_TURNOVER pseudo-actor events.

check_contracts_models.reason: Legacy flat bundle models/feature_cols.pkl is quarantined by feature_schema_v4 because it declares forbidden current-game *_TEAM outcomes (AST_TEAM, DREB_TEAM, FGA_TEAM, FTA_TEAM, OREB_TEAM, PTS_TEAM, REB_TEAM, TOV_TEAM). This is documented intended behavior per AGENTS.md and src/contracts/features.py until the bundle is retrained; it is not a regression caused by this PR.
check_contracts_models.allowed_migration_mode: --allow-legacy-artifacts (explicitly unsafe; never eligible for replay or promotion)

exit_gate.criteria: Baseline artifact exists and no production file changed.
